_comment: User-facing texts (interface language: EN, tz section 8). Synced into table templates by scripts/sync-config.sh. {{var}} is HTML-escaped, {{{var}}} is inserted as is. Telegram parse mode: HTML.
start.unknown: 👋 Hi! This is AI Content Factory — it turns raw notes, voice messages and documents into ready-to-publish posts for every channel of a brand. Access is by invitation only. You can ask for access or try the demo: send any material and get a preview package (nothing gets published).
invite.invalid: ⚠️ This invitation link is invalid, already used or expired. Ask your manager for a new one.
invite.created: 🔗 Invitation link ({{role}}, valid {{hours}} h, one use): {{link}}
help.author: How to use Send me anything: text, a voice message, photos, PDF, DOCX, XLSX/CSV or a link. Messages sent within a minute are merged into one material. Add hints in free form: brand, platforms, date and time, tone, “digest only”, “urgent”. /m <id> — material history and cost /intake — your personal email address for materials /notify each|batch|off — “published” notifications /panel — open the web panel /cancel — stop the current dialog
help.editor: Editor Package cards arrive here: approve, edit, redo with a comment, change time, replace the visual, reject. /pause <brand> [platform] · /resume — stop publishing /digest <brand> [now] — next newsletter /report <brand> — report for the last 7 days /myemail <address> — for newsletter test sends
help.manager: Manager /profile <brand> — brand config as YAML (edit and send it back) /onboard <brand> — draft a profile from existing posts /examples <brand> — learned examples from edits /invite <role> <brand[,brand]> · /revoke @user <brand> · /users <brand> /budget <brand> — AI spend this month
help.admin: Admin /newbrand <slug> <Name> — create a brand /invite admin · /budget <brand> <usd> /pause all — stop all publishing /jobs · /retry <job> — failed background jobs /eval [generation|routing] — run the quality eval set
intake.unsupported: this type of content is not supported ({{what}}). Send text, voice, images (JPG/PNG/WebP), PDF, DOCX, XLSX/CSV or a link.
intake.too_long_text: the text is too long: {{chars}} characters (limit {{limit}}).
intake.too_many_images: too many images in one material (limit {{limit}}).
intake.empty: nothing readable was found in the material.
intake.address: 📧 Your personal address for materials: {{address}} The subject, text and attachments of emails sent there become materials.
ack.collecting: 📥 {{material}} received: {{parts}}. I’ll start in ~{{seconds}} s — send more messages to add them to this material.
ack.waiting: ⏳ {{material}} is waiting for your answer (see the question below).
ack.routed: 🧭 {{material}} → {{brands}} variants in progress. Editors will get the card; I’ll tell you when it’s published.
material.budget_blocked: ⏸ Generation for {{material}} is paused: the monthly AI budget is used up. The material is safe in the queue and will continue when the budget is raised or next month.
material.failed: ⚠️ Processing of {{material}} failed after several attempts. The administrators have been notified; the material is kept and will be retried once the problem is fixed.
q.duplicate: ♻️ {{material}} looks like {{original}} from {{date}}. Create a new package anyway?
q.clarify: ❓ {{material}}: there isn’t enough to write a good post. {{question}} Reply with text or voice. Without an answer in {{hours}} h I’ll continue with what I have.
q.brand_multi: 🏷 Choose one or more brands for {{material}}, then tap “Create packages”:
q.offtopic: 🤔 {{material}} doesn’t seem to fit any of your brands. {{reason}} Choose a brand or cancel.
q.email_note: (Your material came by email — please answer here.)
route.no_brands: you have no active brands to publish for.
route.brand_not_ready: ⚠️ Brand {{brand}} has no active profile yet — ask a manager to finish onboarding.
route.no_platforms: ⚠️ {{brand}} has no matching active platforms for {{material}}.
card.low_data: 🟡 Low source data: the author didn’t add details.
approval.reminder: ⏰ Not approved yet: {{platform}} for {{brand}} ({{material}}). Slot {{slot}} is in {{hours}} h.
approval.missed: ⏭ {{platform}} for {{brand}} ({{material}}) was not approved by {{missed}} and was not published. Moved to {{next}}.
publish.unknown: ⚠️ Unknown result: {{platform}} · {{brand}} · {{material}}. The request may or may not have reached the platform. Please check {{target}} and choose — I won’t retry by myself to avoid a duplicate.
reject.comment: Add a comment for the brand’s learning (or tap Skip):
reject.saved: ⛔ Rejected. The reason is saved to the brand feedback.
edit.prompt: ✏️ Send the new text for {{platform}} as one message. Current version:
edit.saved: ✔ Saved as a new version; checks are running.
edit.published_prompt: ✏️ Send the corrected text; the published post will be updated where the platform allows it. Current version:
redo.prompt: ✍️ What should change? One message, e.g. “shorter, no emoji, mention the new opening hours”.
redo.preset.shorter: Make it noticeably shorter; keep only the key message and the call to action.
redo.preset.formal: Use a more formal, professional tone.
redo.preset.casual: Use a more casual, conversational tone.
time.prompt: ⌨️ Send the date and time in the brand time zone ({{tz}}), e.g. 2026-10-01 18:00, 01.10 18:00, 18:00 or tomorrow 9:30.
time.bad_format: I couldn’t read that time. Examples: 2026-10-01 18:00, 01.10 18:00, 18:00, tomorrow 9:30.
remove.confirm: Remove this platform from the package? It won’t be published.
delete.confirm: Delete the published post from the platform?
visual.upload_prompt: 📤 Send the image (photo or JPG/PNG/WebP file). I’ll crop it for every platform.
redirect.choose: ↪️ Send this material to which brand? A new package will be created there and this one cancelled.
err.forbidden: You don’t have permission for this.
err.card_outdated: The card was outdated — refreshed. Please check the new version.
err.not_pending: This is no longer awaiting approval.
err.time_in_past: That time is in the past.
err.already_published: Something from this package is already published — redirect is not possible.
err.package_exists: That brand already has a package for this material.
err.not_publishing: The post is not in publishing state.
err.too_late_cancel: Too late to cancel — the material is already being turned into posts. Ask an editor to reject the package.
err.brand_required: You have several brands — add the brand slug. /brands
err.unknown_user: Unknown user. Use @username or the Telegram id.
usage.newbrand: Usage: /newbrand <slug> <Brand name> (slug: latin letters, digits, hyphens)
access.not_member: That user had no access to this brand.
pause.created: ⏸ Publishing paused ({{scope}}). Scheduled posts are kept. /resume to continue.
pause.list: ⏸ Active pauses — choose how to resume:
budget.warning: 💰 AI budget of {{account}} is at 80%+: {{spent}} of {{limit}}.
budget.exhausted: 🛑 AI budget of {{account}} is used up: {{spent}} of {{limit}}. Generation is paused, intake continues.
profile.draft_saved: 📝 Draft v{{version}} of {{brand}} saved. Activate it when ready.
profile.activated: ✅ {{brand}}: profile v{{version}} is active. New packages use it; existing packages keep their version.
profile.budget_admin_only: ℹ️ The budget change was ignored: only admins can change budgets.
profile.export_caption: 📄 {{brand}} config, profile v{{version}} ({{status}}). Edit and send the file back to create a new draft.
profile.yaml_header:
Brand config: {{brand}} (profile v{{version}}).
Edit and send this file back to the bot; it becomes a new draft version that a manager activates.
Sections: brand (name, timezone, blog_domain, monthly_budget_usd - admins only),
profile (basics, voice, required_elements, visual, examples, platforms overrides, digest - see schemas/brand-profile.schema.json),
platforms (platform, language, mode: real|preview, active, auto_publish, target, schedule), feeds (RSS URLs, max 10).
onboarding.start: 🚀 Onboarding {{brand}}: send 5–10 existing posts — links or texts, one per message (forwarding channel posts works too). Then send /done.
onboarding.drafting: 🧪 Drafting the brand profile from your samples…
onboarding.draft_ready: 📝 Draft profile v{{version}} for {{brand}} is ready (YAML attached). Edit anything and send the file back, or activate it as is. Set the Telegram channel in platforms → target → chat_id.
guest.menu: 🎮 Demo mode: pick a demo brand, or describe your business in one sentence and I’ll build a temporary brand. Then send any material — you’ll get a preview package; nothing is published.
guest.brand_selected: ✅ Demo brand: {{brand}}. Now send a text, voice message, photo, PDF or link.
guest.describe: ✍️ Describe your business in one sentence, e.g. “A family bakery in Lisbon with vegan pastries”.
guest.brand_ready: ✅ Temporary brand {{brand}} is ready (kept for {{hours}} h). Send your material.
guest.limit: 🎮 The demo allows {{limit}} materials per day. Come back tomorrow!
guest.rejected_content: the demo doesn’t process offensive or illegal content. {{reason}}
digest.skipped: ⏭ {{brand}}: the newsletter for {{date}} is skipped — only {{blocks}} block(s) collected (minimum 2).
digest.not_approved: ⏭ {{brand}}: the newsletter was not approved in time and was not sent.
eval.started: 🧪 Eval run #{{run}} started: {{cases}} cases. The summary arrives here when every case is final.
admin.no_editors: ⚠️ {{brand}} has no editors — the card for {{material}} went nowhere. Invite an editor.
admin.unknown_sender: 👤 Unknown sender {{user}} (tg id {{tg_id}}) sent a material; it was not accepted.
admin.access_request: 🔑 Access request from {{user}} ({{name}}, tg id {{tg_id}}). Create an invite: /invite <role> <brand>
admin.unknown_email: 📧 Email from unknown sender {{from}} was not accepted.
admin.bot_added: 🤖 The bot was added to “{{title}}” as {{status}}. chat_id: {{chat_id}}
email.received_html:
Your material {{material}} was received: {{parts}}.

If I have questions, I’ll ask in Telegram.

— AI Content Factory
email.no_access_html: This address accepts materials only from invited users, sent to their personal intake address. Ask your manager for an invitation to the Telegram bot; the bot command /intake shows your address.
email.confirm_html:
Please confirm that you want to receive the {{brand}} newsletter:

Confirm subscription

If you didn’t subscribe, just ignore this email.
